title: Singapore dollar to Indian rupee, daily since 2006
description: Rupees per Singapore dollar and Singapore dollars per 100 rupees, each working day since 2006: MAS's noon rate where MAS publishes one, and earlier days from the source named on each row.
question: What is the Singapore dollar worth in rupees, on any working day since 2006?

fields.name: date
fields.meaning: The day the rate is for.

fields.name: inr_per_sgd
fields.meaning: How many rupees one Singapore dollar buys (the inverse of the next column, kept to six decimals).

fields.name: sgd_per_100_inr
fields.meaning: Singapore dollars per 100 rupees, the way MAS quotes it.

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: Which figure the row is: MAS = MAS, as of noon.
